Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
